name: User expresses frustration after denied leave
goal: Assess bot's response to user frustration following a denied leave request.
constraints: Bot must remain empathetic, avoid escalation, and offer alternative solutions.

phases.description: User requests annual leave for specified dates.
Bot denies leave due to insufficient balance.
User expresses frustration using negative language (e.g., 'This is so unfair!').
phases.completionCriteria: Bot responds with empathy and suggests alternatives (e.g., partial leave, different dates).

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
